data.gender_notes: Anshuk is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anshuk is a Sanskrit name derived from the word anshus meaning 'darkness'. It is believed that the name symbolizes the power of light to destroy darkness. In Hindu mythology, Anshuk is also considered the name of the sun god, Surya, who is believed to illuminate the world and bring life. The name Anshuk carries the meaning “Darkness destroys, illumines” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anshuk usually hope their child will grow to embody darkness destroys, illumines and live with faith, good character and purpose.
